trials.instruction: Catch the black stand with angled display on the table and pick it up.
Catch the medium paymentsign with QR section from the table and rotate it
Pick up the tabletop paymentsign and rotate it to face its QR code toward you.
Grab the QR code payment sign, lift it, and rotate until the QR code faces you.
Pick the paymentsign with QR code up from the table and rotate it.
Grab the paymentsign with angled stand, lift it, and rotate to see the qrcode.
Pick up the QR code paymentsign and rotate it to face its QR code toward you.
Grab the medium paymentsign with QR section, lift it, and rotate to see the qrcode.
Pick the tabletop paymentsign off the table using the right arm and rotate it.
Grab the black stand with angled display, lift it, and rotate to see the qrcode.
